name: Enzyme Substrate Causal Context
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The disease-associated enzyme has the candidate drug as a substrate The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_substrate. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to.
hypothesis: A disease-linked enzyme substrate may provide metabolic intervention or replacement context.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The disease-associated enzyme has the candidate drug as a substrate The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_substrate. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to.

mechanism.rationale: A disease-linked enzyme substrate may provide metabolic intervention or replacement context. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[substrate:{{relationship_types:substrate}}]->(chemical:Drug) WHERE substrate.predicate IN {{predicates:substrate}} AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl"] WHERE source IN coalesce(substrate.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: substrate: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Metabolic processing can affect drug exposure without treating the enzyme-linked disease; this is an association diagnostic.
